title: Dostai, Father of Rabbi Aptoriki
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Chullin 64b has Dostai, father of Rabbi Aptoriki, reciting: “This was taught only when it was found on the egg white,” etc. Bava Metzia 5a calls him only the father of Rabbi Aptoriki. Hyman infers that he was one of the baraita reciters, the tannaim, and was not ordained. His son was better known, so he was designated by his son’s name.

notes.text: The Chullin passage concerns blood found on an egg’s white or yolk; חלבון is egg white, not part of the liver. Hyman describes a professional reciter of baraitot and infers lack of ordination from his designation by his better-known son.
